summary: Nyxoah SA filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 9, 2026, attaching three press releases issued between June 29 and July 7, 2026. The filing includes a transparency notification under Belgian law reporting that entities controlled by Orin Hirchman crossed the 10% threshold, holding 14.55% of voting rights as of June 10, 2026. This is a routine ownership disclosure filing, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic event is described. As a foreign private issuer, the Form 6-K is equivalent to a U.S. Schedule 13D beneficial ownership filing update.
